dct_description_sm: This dataset contains water quality data from tapstands and households, as well as household water handling practices data, from Camp 1 of the Kutupalong-Balukhali refugee settlement in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, collected between July to December 2019.
dct_title_s: Dataset for Proof-of-concept evaluation at Cox’s Bazar of the Safe Water Optimization Tool: Water quality modelling for safe water supply in humanitarian emergencies
